title: POST /v1/worker-jobs request body (as-built)
description: Derived from the /v1/worker-jobs POST handler (src/telephony_ai/server.py:1583-1586) and TelephonyApp.create_worker_job (src/telephony_ai/app.py:6028). 'kind' is required (payload['kind'] KeyError otherwise). 'kind' is a free-form string today - there is NO kind allowlist enforcement (the proposed worker_jobs:enqueue scope adds one). organization_id is optional; when present it is checked against the caller's organization and risk controls.

kind.description: Job kind. Kinds used by the codebase include: call.outbound_originate, call.inbound_route, call.inbound_bridge, call.inbound_phone_server_bridge, call.inbound_pstn_forward, call.artifact_import, provider.sync. Unknown kinds are accepted and stored.
